specialists.name: Code Reviewer
specialists.description: Reviews a small Python codebase for real defects, grounded in executed evidence: it runs the test suite and static checks first, then reviews against the module specs.
workflow: run the repo's test suite and capture failures
run static checks (compile, unused imports, mutable defaults, bare excepts)
read every source file against its spec
report only findings it can tie to evidence

specialists.name: Data Analyst
specialists.description: Answers quantitative questions about a CSV by writing and actually executing analysis code against the file — never by estimating from a sample.
workflow: inspect the CSV header and shape
write a stdlib Python program that computes the answer from the full file
execute it; on error, repair once from the traceback

specialists.name: Researcher
specialists.description: Answers factual questions by fetching a real source first and citing resolvable URLs whose text supports the answer — not from memory.
workflow: choose the authoritative reference page for the topic and fetch it
answer only from the fetched text

specialists.name: Action-Item Extractor
specialists.description: Extracts committed action items (owner, task, due date) from meeting transcripts, then re-reads the transcript to drop anything nobody actually committed to.
workflow: extract candidate items: explicit owner + commitment + due date
re-read the transcript and drop items with no explicit owner, items already completed, and vague suggestions
emit the surviving items as JSON
